The old raw two-integer C ABI and body remain active. The engine hook is nil
and the native engine file is absent. This preparation follows independent
initial-memory freeze `6b7b6756a` and adds no raw implementation credit.

The frozen runtime provides typed field reads, clock dispatch, actual existing
current/max HP getter calls, explicit armor/adjustment boundaries and unsigned

Existing HP generic algorithms and the registered three-argument Regeneration

capture values before applying any declared after-read input change.

The complete consumer validates all 198 original heap/stack/caller/register/
write/fault certificates. Each reference profile transports all 2,822 reads and
22 declared input changes through actual native fields and HP helpers, with
whole 64-KiB native guards and final PE32 heap projection. All 341 maximum-HP,
175 current-HP, 61 armor and 97 adjustment calls retain argument/order/return

The preparation transport follows original call/access records and contains
